answer.likely_change: Most of the issue is already in the base: the SIGUSR1 restart-when-idle, the handover of the control socket, the 3 s quiet outage in openagents-chat, and the "Reconnecting to OpenAgents… (Esc stops / Ctrl-C stops)" wording all exist (commit 869fbe15 is an ancestor of HEAD). The missing piece is the new pub fn stop_taking_requests(&self) on Running in crates/coder-host/src/serve/mod.rs, which stops new requests on every path (control socket, relay, direct) so drain can finish. Call it in crates/coder-host/src/cli.rs before running.drain(DRAIN) on the SIGTERM stop path and on the restart path, and have the control accept loop refuse or hold new requests while the flag is set. The coderos-hosts oa-terminal-dev script is not in this repo (no match for oa-terminal-dev or build-only outside docs), so it is out of scope here.
acceptance: Running::stop_taking_requests(&self) exists in crates/coder-host/src/serve/mod.rs with exactly that signature.
After stop_taking_requests, no new request is accepted on the control socket, relay, or direct channel.
A stop (SIGTERM) calls stop_taking_requests and then drains requests being answered, for up to 10 s.
A restart for an update (SIGUSR1) waits until idle and hands the bound control socket to the new program; clients connecting meanwhile wait in the socket queue.
An outage shorter than 3 s prints nothing in the terminal and in openagents chat; Online is only reported after an Offline.
The reconnect wording is 'Reconnecting to OpenAgents… (Esc stops)' in the terminal and '(Ctrl-C stops)' in openagents chat, and the rail says 'reconnecting · Esc stops'.
The oa-terminal-dev changes (interactive-only background rebuild, --build-only never rebuilds, SIGUSR1 instead of hard restart) are in coderos-hosts, which is not in this repository.
